eradication.description: team-based territory shooter. take the town back from furries.
eradication.pageDescription: ERADICATION is a team shooter on Roblox by Low Quality Interactive. take the town back from the Furries. free to play.
eradication.pageLead: fight through the furries. survive as long as you can.
eradication.faqWhatIs: ERADICATION is a team shooter on Roblox. you play a contractor. the town's overrun by Furries. you take it back.
eradication.faqHowToPlay: two teams. seven flags. take six of them off the Furries and a tunnel opens up under the town. don't stand on a Pimple when it dies.

donpollo-obby.pageDescription: DON POLLO OBBY is a Roblox obby by Low Quality Interactive. sunset. another low quality classic.
donpollo-obby.pageLead: obstacle chaos. fast restarts. speedrun routes if you want them.
donpollo-obby.artworkAlt: Don Pollo Obby floating course artwork
donpollo-obby.faqWhatIs: DON POLLO OBBY is a Roblox obby. sunset. still playable. another low quality classic.

favela-94.description: close-quarters tactical shooter set in the favelas of 1994.
favela-94.pageDescription: Favela '94 is a tactical Roblox shooter set in 1994 Rio. by Low Quality Interactive. preview.
favela-94.artworkAlt: Favela '94 cover art - armed operators in a 1994 Rio favela alley
favela-94.faqWhatIs: Favela '94 is a Roblox tactical shooter set in 1994 Rio. close-quarters, short rounds. preview.
favela-94.faqHowToPlay: alleys, rooftops, short fights. pick a loadout. don't peek the same angle twice.
